name: NAVTTC LMS
summary: Taking a learning management system into production.
description: Production go-live work for a nationwide learning management system in partnership with NAVTTC. Responsibilities covered data migration, deployment, institute onboarding, and post-launch support.
challenge: A learning platform rollout must bring existing data, participating institutes, and operational support into a reliable production environment.
approach: Coordinate production readiness, migrate real data, deploy the application, support institute onboarding, and resolve issues after launch in collaboration with stakeholders.
